readError: The authorized conversations can't be read right now. Check the Personal Chrome plugin and try again.

issue.HELPER_UPDATE_REQUIRED: The connection component needs an update; existing authorizations are kept. Fix it in the plugin settings, then refresh.
issue.HELPER_NOT_INSTALLED: The local connection component isn't ready yet. Check it in the plugin settings.
issue.EXTENSION_RELOAD_REQUIRED: The Chrome extension needs a reload; existing authorizations are kept. Reload it, then refresh the names.
issue.PAGE_RELOAD_REQUIRED: The conversation page still uses the old connection. Reload that page, then choose "Check conversation page" for it in the plugin settings. Existing authorizations are kept.
issue.STALE_HELPER: The connection component was updated, but Chrome still uses the old one. Reload the extension, then refresh.
issue.STALE_HELPER_PROTOCOL: Chrome still uses the old connection component. Update it in the plugin settings and reload the extension.
issue.CHROME_DISCONNECTED: Can't reach Chrome right now. Make sure the extension is connected, then refresh the names.
issue.TITLE_SYNC_TIMEOUT: Name sync timed out. Make sure the Chrome extension is connected and try again.
issue.AUTHORIZATION_INVALID: The conversation authorizations can't be read right now. Check them in the plugin settings.
issue.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: Name sync isn't supported on this system.
issue.failed: Name sync didn't finish this time. Try again later; saved names are kept.
issue.none: No names to sync were found. Open the conversation, wait for its title to load, then refresh.
issue.partial: Synced {0} conversation names. The others have no name yet; open those conversations, then refresh.
